description: This file is a server-side module for managing 'cases' in a Django-CRM-based project. It handles loading case data, parsing URL parameters, and defining server-side actions such as create, update, delete, comment, and move cases. It communicates with backend APIs, transforms responses for frontend use, and manages form submissions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes cases data, along with related entities and options, for rendering the cases list page. Handles URL parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination, and transforms API data into frontend-compatible structures.
